paper.title_en: Probing past mergers of supermassive black holes with pulsar timing arrays: The role of pulsar terms
paper.abstract_en: By monitoring the times of arrival of radio pulses from millisecond pulsars, Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) serve as unique gravitational wave (GW) laboratories in the nanohertz band. To date, the primary astrophysical sources of GWs targeted in this frequency range have been inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) on circular and eccentric orbits. In this work, we demonstrate that, thanks to the so-called pulsar term in the timing residual waveform of GW signals, PTAs can probe individual SMBHBs that merged before timing observations began. We refer to the latter as zombie binaries. Using SMBHB population models consistent with current PTA constraints, we find that while the probability of detecting such systems in existing PTA datasets remains low, the Square Kilometer Array observatory is expected to achieve sufficient sensitivity to have a few zombie binaries with optimal matched filter signal-to-noise ratios exceeding 3 in its data. Although their confident identification might be challenging, this new class of PTA sources opens a novel window for studying the most massive SMBHBs in our local universe.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出利用脉冲星计时阵列探测已并合的超大质量黑洞双星（"僵尸双星"），概念新颖，方法严谨，对未来观测有重要指导意义。
decision.title_zh: 利用脉冲星计时阵列探测超大质量黑洞的过去并合：脉冲星项的作用
decision.abstract_zh: 通过监测毫秒脉冲星射电脉冲到达时间，脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）在纳赫兹频段作为独特的引力波（GW）实验室。迄今为止，该频率范围内主要的探测目标是处于旋近阶段、轨道为圆形或椭圆形的超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHBs）。在这项工作中，我们证明，由于计时残差波形中的所谓脉冲星项，PTAs 可以探测在计时观测开始之前就已经并合的单个 SMBHBs。我们将后者称为僵尸双星。利用与当前 PTA 约束一致的黑洞双星种群模型，我们发现尽管在现有 PTA 数据集中探测到此类系统的概率仍然较低，但平方千米阵（SKA）有望达到足够的灵敏度，使其数据中有一批最优匹配滤波信噪比超过 3 的僵尸双星。虽然它们的可靠识别可能具有挑战性，但这类新的 PTA 源为我们研究本地宇宙中最庞大的 SMBHBs 打开了一个新的窗口。
